column3: Claudian verses, stanza 10, lines 3-4: "All'hor, ch'haurà pietà de' nostri mali / Febo, che questi à modo suo dispensa" — EN swaps the two lines ("when Phoebus, who dispenses them as he wills, / shall have pity on our ills,"), violating line-for-line order; correct: "when there shall have pity on our ills / Phoebus, who dispenses them as he wills,".
